summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating: (1) Effect Strength (1..10) solidness vs. transparency and density scaling up to 100% opaque (alpha = 255, zero see-through) across all overlay styles and WebView overlays, (2) careful, non-destructive LiteRT tensor & frame-processing optimizations, (3) gender-isolated detection accuracy (Female vs. Male face + linked skin/body region without opposite-gender false positives), (4) real-time unoccluded region tracking, and (5) opt-in pre-blur setting for newly appearing media.
